name: SpiceJet Limited
about: SpiceJet Limited engages in the provision of air transportation services. The company operates through Air Transport, and Freighter and Logistics Services segments. It offers passengers and cargo air transportation services under the SpiceJet brand name. The company also operates fleets covering routes, including domestic and international destinations. SpiceJet Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India.
